description: Brings back an earlier version of a knowledge entry by saving its content as a NEW newest version, and brings back a deleted entry too. Nothing is overwritten: every version stays in the history, and the restore shows there as a new version saved by the assistant. Send the version to bring back and the newest version number (list_knowledge_versions gives both); if someone saved a newer version since, nothing is saved and the answer is stale with the newest number.

expected_version.description: The entry's newest version number when you read it (read_knowledge or list_knowledge_versions gives it). If someone saved a newer version since, nothing changes and the answer is stale with the newest number: read the entry again first.

knowledge_id.description: The entry (list_knowledge and search_knowledge give ids).

project_id.description: The project the entry is in. May be left out: the entry's id finds its own project or the workspace.

version.description: The number of the version whose content to bring back.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: restore_knowledge_version
title: Bring back an earlier version of a knowledge entry
